data.name: Brain Drain
data.description: You can take a standard action to violently probe the mind of a single intelligent enemy within 100 feet. The target receives a Will save (DC %1) to negate the effect and immediately knows the source of this harmful mental prying. Those who fail this save are wracked with pain, taking %2d%3 points of damage. After successfully attacking with this ability, you may use a full-round action to sort through the jumble of stolen thoughts and memories to make a single Knowledge check using the victim's skill bonus. The randomly stolen thoughts remain in your mind for %4 rounds. Treat the knowledge gained as if you had used detect thoughts. This is a mind-affecting effect. You can use this ability %5/day.|BrainDrainDC|BrainDrainDice|BrainDrainDieType|BrainDrainDuration|BrainDrainTimes
